Task: Setup project repository and folder structure
Description: Create a well-organized project scaffold with separate folders for FastAPI backend, LangChain RAG logic, DB utils, and vector index logic.

Task: Configure .env and install dependencies
Description: Create .env for secrets (Mongo URI, Pinecone, OpenAI) and install necessary packages like FastAPI, LangChain, Pinecone, Motor, Pydantic, etc.

Task: Build FastAPI boilerplate with health check route
Description: Create a simple FastAPI app with a /health endpoint to verify the server is running.

Task: Design MongoDB/DynamoDB schema for users, sessions, messages
Description: Define schema or collections for user profiles, chat sessions, and messages with proper timestamp and session grouping.

Task: Implement POST /start_session to initiate user sessions
Description: Create an API route that starts a new chat session, saving user ID and start time.

Task: Implement POST /chat endpoint to accept and respond to messages
Description: Accept user input and return a placeholder response. Later, wire it to the RAG engine.

Task: Store chat messages (user + bot) in the DB
Description: Ensure every message exchanged is stored in the appropriate session with metadata.

Task: Implement GET /sessions/{user_id} to fetch session history
Description: Create an endpoint to fetch previous chat sessions with timestamps and summaries.

Task: Setup LangChain with OpenAI and test static prompt
Description: Initialize LangChain with GPT-4 or Claude and test static message flow before adding RAG.

Task: Load immigration documents and chunk using LangChain
Description: Load PDFs, websites, or text, and split them into chunks using RecursiveCharacterSplitter or similar.

Task: Create Pinecone index and embed immigration knowledge
Description: Use OpenAI or Instructor embeddings to store chunks in Pinecone for retrieval.

Task: Build retriever logic with Pinecone for relevant chunk fetching
Description: Use LangChain retriever to query Pinecone and return top-k relevant documents.

Task: Build RAG chain: query → retrieve → prompt → response
Description: Integrate retriever with LLM and LangChain QA chain to return grounded, relevant answers.

Task: Connect /chat endpoint with full RAG response pipeline
Description: Wire the user input to go through the RAG pipeline and return an enriched answer.

Task: Fetch USCIS, SEVP, ICE RSS feeds
Description: Use feedparser or requests to fetch live immigration feeds from .gov sites.

Task: Summarize immigration headlines using LLM
Description: Use map-reduce or stuff chain summarization to distill multiple news articles.

Task: Build GET /news to expose summarized news
Description: Expose an endpoint returning recent summaries for frontend display.

Task: Enable real-time news detection from user queries
Description: Use keyword or intent detection to dynamically fetch and summarize breaking immigration news.

Task: Create visa-type-based rules for auto task generation
Description: Write rule logic based on visa type (e.g., F-1 = update SEVIS in 10 days of move).

Task: Implement task generation logic and DB schema
Description: Store user-specific task deadlines and status. Auto-generate based on profile.

Task: Set up deadline-based reminders (cron/email placeholders)
Description: Build a task scheduler (CRON job or Celery) to trigger reminders for pending compliance tasks.

Task: Write unit tests for APIs, DB writes, RAG
Description: Use pytest to ensure endpoints, session logic, and RAG return as expected.

Task: Dockerize the app for production deployment
Description: Create a Dockerfile for the FastAPI app and ensure local builds work.

Task: Deploy to AWS/GCP (EC2 or Cloud Run)
Description: Host the bot backend on the cloud and expose via API Gateway or public IP.

Task: Add logging + error tracking (Sentry or built-in logs)
Description: Use standard logging or error monitoring to trace and debug production issues.

Task: Add JWT user authentication + auth middleware
Description: Implement secure login and attach auth to protected routes like /chat, /news.

Task: Add user memory (remember visa type in session)
Description: Store current visa and country in session metadata to personalize responses.

Task: Add disclaimer to bot for legal compliance
Description: Every response should include a line like “This is not legal advice” when relevant.
